steps.content:
6:38 p.m., November 23, N.F. 113
Exiles - East 19 Underground Base

After the suppression of the rebellion, the Executive Committee has regained control of West District. As such, there exist a number of secret non-cooperative organization bases like this one. The so-called comprehensive census brings considerable pressure to these exiles. Many bases have already relocated multiple times since November.
Presently, Matilda, a clerical officer of the Executive Committee, is confirming the details of the relocation with Lavina who's in charge of the base.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: The food and medical supplies can still hold up. There used to be many Outlanders in the Drifter Camp, and they've established some channels for us. We can still hold on for a while.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: The biggest issue is still Hypercubes. Nirvana has completely cut off supply to civilians in the West District, and this affected trade with Outland as well. The only place to get Hypercubes is still Mine W-31.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I remember it was that Chief who wiped out that half of the Corpus at the bottom of W-31. Coupled with the new BR-002 outbreak, the old Black Ring here was rendered completely inactive and became a small usable Hypercube mine.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: In a sense, the previous goal of Rustfire has indeed been achieved.

Only then does she notice that Lavina's face has turned gloomy. During the first Drifter Camp Mania crisis, Lavina was contaminated by Corpus 002, and it was ${PlayerName} who suppressed the Mania in her body with the shackles.
But now Chief is missing, and the life-saving shackles he left behind have become the source of contamination. This fact and chronic exhaustion have left the strong woman visibly weary.
steps.female_content: But now Chief is missing, and the life-saving shackles she left behind have become the source of contamination. This fact and chronic exhaustion have left the strong woman visibly weary.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: ...Rustfire is no more. Those gathering here are all refugees.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Right, Rustfire is gone and Syndicate has no future. Miss Carbonara, how about packing up the people here and taking them to Eastside?

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: You care a lot about everyone, don't you? You must hate to see them suffer again.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: My last name is Cavendish. And yes, I do care. That's why I'm trying to find a way out.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: A way out... Haha, not everyone believes there is one.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Or you can just send me away? You see, I've helped you a lot, haven't I?

Corso raises an eyebrow at Matilda with her completely insincere request. In fact, it's more of a taunt. It's not that this former Rustfire fighter bears any grudge against the Eastsider Executive Officer. Quite the contrary...
The natural fighter greatly enjoyed the violent games of Syndicate in the past. The current lifeless West District bores her silly, and not a minute goes by she doesn't wish she's fighting someone.

But most of her fellow enthusiasts have already died in the eight months following the reappearance of the Black Ring, or have simply been scared out of their wits that they're no longer able to play with her.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I'll consider it. The relocation of the base will begin in a while. There may be danger along the path, could you scout it beforehand?
Corso waves her hand listlessly.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Boring Corruptors again. Fine, fine, I'll go.
Having sent Corso away, Matilda returns to Lavina's side, attempting to make up for her slip of the tongue.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I'm deeply sorry for the loss of Rustfire, but besides the frontline fighters, Rustfire still has you and many non-combatants, as well as tens of thousands of Drifter Camp dwellers.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: During the March upheaval, you kept them safe from the riots while enduring the contamination. Since then, you've been gathering supplies under such dangerous circumstances, sustaining the operations of over a dozen bases, and protecting many people.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: You've safeguarded Rustfire as the one in charge of logistics. You've proven to be more reliable than many commissioners in Eastside.
Lavina stares blankly at Matilda. After a moment, she lowers her gaze.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: ...You're giving me too much credit.
Lavina doesn't find comfort in that, perhaps because it comes from an Eastsider Executive Officer, or her pain is just too immense to be alleviated by any words of consolation.
Perhaps to her, it seemed like Rustfire had weathered the toughest years only to fall in the most absurd manner.

March 22: The obituary of the MBCC's Chief and Rustfire's titular leader ${PlayerName} was issued. Rustfire, who shared the shackles' power, announced retaliation. March 23: Claimed the ruins of Inner Bay BR-002, the previous site of Mine W-31. March 26: Occupied the headquarters of the West District Reconstruction Executive Committee, seizing a large amount of classified information. March 29: Rustfire completed internal purges. With unified and determined conviction, they vowed to take revenge and reclaim everything that belonged to Syndicate. April 1: All major locations in West District had been taken over. With peaked morale, Rustfire planned to return to the Drifter Camp, breach the isolation belt of the Rust, and take back the East.

Influenced by public opinion from unknown sources, Rustfire received a massive batch of devoted new recruits. They gained Mania power similar to the shackles from the unconscious ${PlayerName} and became invincible for a time. In just ten days, they reclaimed what used to be theirs and struck back, achieving the unprecedented glory of Ten Days of Rustfire.

Also on the evening of April 1, architect Julien left Rustfire, quitting his long-time station Drifter Camp. On his way to Inner Bay, he detonated BR-002, bringing the Black Ring back to West District. Those Rustfire Sinners who gained the shackles-like power from the unconscious ${PlayerName} were the first to be swallowed by Mania. The Drifter Camp where they gathered instantly became a dead city overrun by Corruptors, the intense contamination reaching even the Rust. This marked the end of the ten glorious days.

What followed were endless suspicion, hatred, and ridicule. The Black Ring failed to awaken anyone. Syndicate fell deeper into chaos. BR-002 quickly developed into the largest and most powerful Secondary Black Ring in history. The Underground tried to approach it. Paradeisos returned to West District to seal it. The remaining Rustfire fanatics, targeted by both forces, claimed themselves as martyrs in delirium.

But that too quickly passed.

After venting their anger and sacrificing everything for their ideals, they found that their passion-driven struggle did not bring any honor, and nothing they did resulted in any change.

A rootless fire eventually goes out. No downpour or epiphany is needed. Time alone is the best extinguisher. With the outbreak of BR-002, Rustfire lost its soldiers, the Drifter Camp, and its leader. Those left behind were no fighters, but just a group of refugees, rendered homeless by the Black Ring and so-called governance, huddling together for warmth.
Time will ruthlessly prove that all vain fanaticism is fleeting and futile. It leaves behind nothing but a mess.
This is not a feeling that someone who has spent her whole life in Eastside can even begin to understand. Matilda won't force herself to. She has other tasks she must tend to.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: We're running out of time. Please gather everyone together. We need to move closer to the central base. At least the Executive Officers will never patrol that place. Converging the bases also lowers Hypercube consumption.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: There may be dangers during the transit. Most Sinners are burdened by the shackles now, so I should be of use.
Lavina nods. The shackles still inflict considerable contamination on her. She tightly grips a small piece of Hypercube on her chest to steady herself.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Thank you. Before that, there's another favor I'd like to ask.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I heard you're someone of influence in Eastside. Do you know of any safe ways to get in touch with the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control?

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I have a wounded person here, an MBCC Sinner. Her contamination is severe, and she's been unconscious since getting critically injured. I can't save her, she needs better treatment.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I know it's dangerous to contact them, but if you have a way to send the child back without exposing us, if it can save her, I'll do anything you ask.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I do have a way, but I wouldn't recommend it, even if it's for the sake of that child.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: As far as I know, the Sinners of the Bureau have also been contaminated by BR-002. The situation is bleak. The Ring Research Institute of Paradeisos has taken over the MBCC for now.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: They're not like that Chief. If a Sinner's condition is judged as too dangerous, they will only be subjected to more brutal treatment.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: If you do care about that child, keep her by your side. At least you would never give up on her, come what may.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: ...I see, thank you. I'm sorry.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: There's nothing you need to apologize to me for.
After seeing Lavina off, Matilda walks through the meandering secret passage and arrives at the isolation ward. She pushes the door open.
[Scene change] Green room (The place in Drifter Camp in Ch.9 where Dudu saves people)

In the narrow single ward, a girl with lilac hair lies there in deep sleep. Her body is covered in wounds, and black spikes emanate from within her ominously. The severity of her symptoms is visible. Matilda remembers the girl's name.

Hella. She was seriously injured by a delirious Mania-infected attacker during the riot. Her ability is rapid regeneration, but as she falls into a deep coma, her power becomes completely suppressed by the superior Mania consciousness on the other end of the shackles.

After ${PlayerName}'s death, the shackles' inhibitory effect on Mania has completely disappeared. The minds of all Sinners and Mania-infected people who have accepted the shackles are now connected to the resurged BR-002.

Those who desire power above all else are granted their wishes after sacrificing their sanity. Those who try to resist and preserve their own senses in vain are punished by the Black Ring, suffering both physically and mentally. Hella, Hecate, and Lavina are all perfect examples.

Matilda doesn't go closer. She sees a thin figure crouched in the shadows by the hospital bed. It's Hecate. She's guarding Hella by her bedside. Behind her, Nightmare is posed to attack anytime, highly alert.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: It's about time to leave. Lavina is really worried about you two.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I don't need Rustfire's pity. They already stole Chief's shackles, what more do they want from me?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Those who stole the shackles and hurt you have already become part of the Black Ring. No one here is your enemy, Hecate.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: And I want nothing to do with them. I'm only here for one reason.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Where is Chief? You said you would keep me posted.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: There's no news right now.
Nightmare roars and charges at Matilda, slamming her against the wall of the ward. Hecate rushes over and grabs Matilda by the collar.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You said the 9th Agency of Paradeisos was out looking for him! After all this time, how can there be no news?
steps.female_content: You said the 9th Agency of Paradeisos was out looking for her! After all this time, how can there be no news?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You're all lying to me. You're in league with Rustfire. <color=#dg1f1f>Where did you take Chief? What did you do to him?</color>
steps.female_content: You're all lying to me. You're in league with Rustfire. <color=#dg1f1f>Where did you take Chief? What did you do to her?</color>

steps.content: As the girl's mood flares up, the black spikes once again pierce through her body. Nightmare trembles with her, and Matilda seizes the chance to grab Hecate's wrist and easily pins her down.
Hecate tries to push her away, but, contamination-laden, there's no way she can win against Matilda.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: The Rustfire you despise has been wiped out. They coveted the shackles and abused their power, that's why they were corrupted by Mania and fell to the bottom. They let hatred burn down their sanity, so they became part of BR-002.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Are you going to follow the same path? You will leave your friend here and turn into a Corruptor before your Chief returns?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You... Let go of me... Let go...
Hecate is stung by her words, but an emotion that hurts more than anger gradually takes over. Her struggle becomes a helpless tremor, as if she's choking back sobs.

Matilda silently releases her restraint. She takes out her emergency anti-Mania shot and injects the girl with it to suppress her contamination. Matilda knows she's not good with words, so she begins simply and frankly.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: It was you who chose to stay, so you could obtain information you couldn't get elsewhere. You decided to stand on our side, then don't push away everything you might need.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Lavina was infected with Mania in the Drifter Camp. It was ${PlayerName} who voluntarily curbed her contamination with the shackles, saving her life while turning her into a Sinner. You were there at the time. You know better than I do.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: She's never asked anything of you. All her efforts to protect you were to repay what that Chief did for her. People have brought you back from the riot. And people out there are still trying to look for your Chief.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: You don't need to trust me. But you should find someone you can trust. Don't isolate yourself. You've already pushed your mind to the breaking point.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Hecate, if you still want to move forward, if you still want to fight for someone, you must first protect your own heart.
The girl finally shows a slight reaction to these words. She pries the Executive Officer's hand off, props herself up, and returns to the side of the bed, lost in thought.
Matilda has said everything that can be said. She's kept her promise and at least brought Hecate to a relatively safe environment. The rest is up to her.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: The Executive Committee will soon return to inspect this area. The refugees have to relocate their base. Do you want to come with us?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Or I can also escort you back to the MBCC, then you can be rid of this place. The refugees can't be detected by the city-state authorities, and you won't see us again.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...I'm going with you. I must get news of Chief firsthand. Don't think of getting rid of me.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Alright, then just guard the patients in the infirmary. The shackles' contamination has worsened. You're not suited for battle in your current state.
Before leaving, Matilda sees Hecate curl up and grip Hella's hand on the bed, trembling. Matilda sighs and gently closes the door.
[Relocation]
Preparation of the East 19 base is complete. The procession moves through the tunnel quietly and slowly, the faces all dejected. Matilda continues to command with a blank expression.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Interference and warning devices have been placed on the ground. To avoid detection by the Executive Committee, we must proceed carefully and cautiously and change paths upon the first signal.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: But it's just as dangerous underground. The area we're heading to is a deeply contaminated zone. Only there can we evade the Executive Committee's search, but it also means that we may encounter Corruptors during the transit.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Those of you still capable of fighting, be prepared. This won't be a smooth journey.
